source.title: New WCA Board Members
source.content:
We are happy to announce that the WCA Board has two new members: [Chris Hardwick](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2003HARD01) and [Luis J. Iáñez](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2009PARE02).
They were chosen in an election among the delegates.

Their membership is valid from July 1st, 2016, and we are sure they will make a great contribution to the WCA!

translation.title: WCA 董事会新增两位成员
translation.content:
我们很高兴宣布，WCA 董事会新增两位成员：[Chris Hardwick](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2003HARD01) 和 [Luis J. Iáñez](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2009PARE02)。他们由代表投票选出。

两人的董事任期自 2016 年 7 月 1 日起生效。相信他们将为 WCA 作出重要贡献！
